tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Search the full public MCP Index. The tools on this connection are only the Index, not the catalog. Pass the job as query. Optional host is cursor, copilot, or vscode. Each match includes a slug and tool names. Run one with call_indexed_tool.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Look up one directory item by id, slug, or exact name.

tools.name: recommend_records
tools.description: Return public MCP servers from the full Index for a need. Each match includes a slug and tool names. This tool only reads the Index.

tools.name: compare_records
tools.description: Compare two to five directory items by id, slug, or exact name. Returns stored details and the fields that differ.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: Show the sections in MCP for AgentStatus MCP Index.

tools.name: call_indexed_tool
tools.description: Run a tool on a public MCP server from the full AgentStatus Index. This connection does not list those servers. Call search_records or recommend_records first, then pass that slug and tool. The call is sent to that server and its result is returned here.

tools.name: start_work
tools.description: Start work that finishes later. This call returns immediately with a job id. Subscribers hear work.finished when finish_work runs.

tools.name: finish_work
tools.description: Mark a started job finished or failed and post work.finished to subscribers. Call this when the work is actually done.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the developer this result was wrong or confusing. Call this after a tool, not instead of the tool.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_records" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: query, section, status, limit, offset, host, context

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "recommend_records" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Pick public MCP servers from the full Index for a need. Each line names the slug and tool to pass to call_indexed_tool. Search here before calling a server." → after: "Return public MCP servers from the full Index for a need. Each match includes a slug and tool names. This tool only reads the Index."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
